title: Tamsin and the Glasshouse
author: Astrid Yarrow
blurb: Coral Galloway, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
